# Licenses of modules that don't ship one

`scripts/third-party-notices.sh` takes each module's license from the module itself. A few modules
are licensed but their released version has no license file; their text is kept here, under the
module path, and used instead.

| Module | Version | Licensed by | Text from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `github.com/mattn/go-localereader` | v0.0.1 (its only tag) | its README: "License: MIT" | upstream `LICENSE`, added after v0.0.1, at [6bae6c92](https://github.com/mattn/go-localereader/blob/6bae6c92/LICENSE) |
